name: Johannesburg
intro: Big energy. Bold ideas. A city that never stops becoming.
descriptions: A hollow cylindrical tower in Berea, once Africa’s tallest apartment building, and still the most unmistakable shape on the Joburg skyline.
A cable-stayed bridge linking Newtown and Braamfontein, named for Mandela and lit above the railway tracks at night.
Soweto’s painted cooling towers, left from a power station and turned into a mural and an adventure jump.

name: Cape Town
intro: Follow the mountain. Find your own kind of adventure.
descriptions: A flat sandstone summit above the city, often wearing a cloud tablecloth, reached by paths or the cableway.
Bright houses and Cape Malay history on the slopes above the city bowl, below Signal Hill.
A rocky headland in Table Mountain National Park, with a lighthouse where the peninsula runs out to sea.

name: Durban
intro: Ocean air, colourful streets, and a rhythm all its own.
descriptions: The stadium arch of the 2010 World Cup, named for Moses Mabhida, with a skywalk and a view along the coast.
A beachfront marine park of aquariums, wrecks and water play on Durban’s Point.
The red-and-white beacon on the rocks at Umhlanga, watching the Indian Ocean north of the city.

name: Pretoria / Tshwane
intro: Jacaranda streets, living history and a stage for new stories.
tag: Jacaranda streets, living history and a stage for new stories.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: A hillside memorial celebrating heritage, remembrance and freedom, with museum spaces above Salvokop.
Sandstone wings and terraced gardens above the administrative capital, a stage for national gatherings.
Drama, dance and music in the capital’s major performing-arts complex.

name: Stellenbosch
intro: Oak-lined streets, garden paths and the stories behind the gables.
tag: Oak-lined streets, garden paths and the stories behind the gables.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: Restored period houses that walk you through centuries of everyday Stellenbosch life.
A compact university garden of plant collections and quiet paths in the middle of town.
Oak-lined Dorp Street, framed by historic Cape Dutch gables and long town stories.

name: Pietermaritzburg
intro: A garden city where red-brick landmarks meet a rich art collection.
tag: A garden city where red-brick landmarks meet a rich art collection.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: Red brick and a clock tower, the landmark heart of Pietermaritzburg’s centre.
South African and international art in the building opposite City Hall.
Indigenous plants and tree-lined walks in the national garden below a green hillside.

name: Gqeberha
intro: Coastal light, public art and unexpected stories beside the bay.
tag: Coastal light, public art and unexpected stories beside the bay.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: A stone pyramid and lighthouse on the hill that looks over Algoa Bay.
A museum of regional natural and cultural history beside the beachfront.
A hotel and entertainment precinct on the Summerstrand beachfront.

name: Bloemfontein
intro: Art-filled gardens and open skies in the heart of the Free State.
tag: Art-filled gardens and open skies in the heart of the Free State.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: Art collections and outdoor sculpture around a former residence on Grant’s Hill.
A valley of indigenous trees, rocky koppies and walking trails.
Theatre, dance and music in Bloemfontein’s landmark performing-arts house.

name: Mbombela
intro: Follow river paths, ancient stone and the warmth of the Lowveld.
tag: Follow river paths, ancient stone and the warmth of the Lowveld.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: Rivers, a waterfall and a canopy of Lowveld plants beside the Crocodile River.
Ancient limestone chambers and sculpted rock, west of the city.
A football stadium whose supports echo giraffe necks, built for the 2010 World Cup.

name: Polokwane
intro: Northern Sotho heritage, local art and a gateway to Limpopo.
tag: Northern Sotho heritage, local art and a gateway to Limpopo.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: A living heritage site where Northern Sotho homes and daily practice are shared outdoors.
Paintings and sculpture from a municipal collection in the city.
A hotel and entertainment retreat a short drive from the city centre.

name: Kimberley
intro: Look beyond the diamond story to art, archives and desert light.
tag: Look beyond the diamond story to art, archives and desert light.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: The historic diamond excavation, with a museum and a reconstructed mining town around the rim.
Natural history and Northern Cape archives in a historic Kimberley building.
A gallery connecting South African art with international collections.

name: Mahikeng
intro: Meet the stories, grasslands and heritage of the North West.
tag: Meet the stories, grasslands and heritage of the North West.
scope: Visitor destination; outlying attractions are labelled in their address
descriptions: Regional collections and the stories of the historic town.
Grassland and wildlife on a quieter edge of the city.
A hotel and villa retreat beside the Leopard Park golf course.
